attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited has approved the audited financial results for the financial year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results based on Audit Committee recommendations during a meeting held on November 25, 2026. The financials were audited by Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP. Newspaper advertisements regarding these results were published in Business Standard and Navshakti on November 27, 2026. The audited financial results and the audit report are available on the company website at https://www.siemens-energy-india.com/financial-results.html. The document was signed by Guilherme Vieira De Mendonca, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, with DIN 09806385. The company's Corporate Identity Number is L28110MH2024PLC418770.

attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited filed a presentation for its Analysts and Institutional Investors call held on November 27, 2026. The company reported that annual revenue crossed 100 Bn rupees for FY2026. Order backlog stood at 145.8 Bn rupees, representing an 11 percent increase from FY2025. Order entry for FY2026 reached 203.6 Bn rupees, a 25.6 percent rise. The company recorded zero fatalities and zero lost time cases. It announced ongoing expansions with 7.4 Bn rupees in investment and a new 20.6 Bn rupees investment for a transformer factory in Ujjain. The presentation also highlighted a 46 percent reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions against a 2019 baseline and the launch of the Energy4Good corporate social responsibility program.

attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited announced changes in its Senior Management following a Board of Directors meeting on November 25, 2026. Effective December 1, 2026, Mr. Anand Jaluka assumes the role of Execution Unit Finance Head for Gas Services Service. He succeeds Ms. Manvi Arora, whose tenure in this specific capacity ends on November 30, 2026. Ms. Arora continues as Execution Unit Finance Head for Grid Technologies Grid Solutions. Mr. Mrinal Ghosh takes over as Execution Unit Finance Head for Grid Technologies Transformers and Switchgears, effective December 1, 2026. Mr. Ghosh retains his existing role as Execution Unit Finance Head for Steam Turbines and Generators. These appointments are part of the company's senior management structure.

attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 25, 2026, recommended Final Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited Board approved audited financial results for the year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 17,809 million rupees, up from 11,001 million rupees in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 102,432 million rupees. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share, totaling 600 percent, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. Payment is scheduled for February 10, 2027. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP issued an unmodified audit opinion on the financial statements. The Board meeting concluded on November 25, 2026.
